# Confirm saved details trim surrounding whitespace without changing the text

## What & Why
The required fields now reject whitespace-only input and trim valid values before persistence, but the browser regression suite does not explicitly protect the normalization behavior for values with intentional surrounding spaces. A focused check would catch future changes that either store accidental padding or remove meaningful internal spaces.

## Done looks like
- Answer titles and content with surrounding whitespace persist without that padding.
- Opportunity company and role values with surrounding whitespace persist without that padding.
- Internal spaces remain unchanged after saving and reloading.
